cohort: The study included placentas from uncomplicated, unlabored full-term pregnancies after elective cesarean section and from vaginal deliveries, along with maternal plasma from the cesarean section group.
finding: IDO1 and TDO2 expression was higher in the maternal side of the placenta, and labor significantly affected TDO2 expression and the plasma Kynurenine/Tryptophan ratio.
mod_finding: Labor, a factor related to mode of birth, significantly affects TDO2 expression and the plasma Kynurenine/Tryptophan ratio.
cross-section timing: Immediately after elective cesarean section or vaginal delivery.
